prompt: Product pages take close to a second to replace the loading skeleton, even on a warm server. Profile what the page waits on and make it faster without changing what it shows.

truth.cause: ProductPage awaits getInventory and then getRatingSummary one after the other although both only need product.id, creating a request waterfall.
truth.summary: getProduct must finish first (the others need its id), but inventory and ratings are independent and should run in parallel with Promise.all.

referenceFix.find:
const inventory = await getInventory(product.id)
  const ratings = await getRatingSummary(product.id)
referenceFix.replace:
const [inventory, ratings] = await Promise.all([
    getInventory(product.id),
    getRatingSummary(product.id),
  ])
